novelty_search.nearest_results: Fresh selective mediation shows that clamping block9 H1/H4 subject-source terms removes 44.7%/48.8% of the block8H1 writer effect, while their source complement removes exactly zero. The remaining 55.3%/51.2% is not localized.
novelty_search.new_question: Is the remaining writer effect transported through the subject residual state across block 9, or rewritten there by attention9/MLP9 updates at the subject positions?

population: All 64 capable fresh Later/Previously A1/A2 rows.

components.block9_entry_z9: The learned carried residual/embedding mixture entering block-9 attention at each subject-onset position.
components.attention9_update: The complete block-9 attention update at each subject-onset position.
components.mlp9_update: The complete block-9 MLP update at each subject-onset position.

factorial.arms: All eight component subsets. Components are drawn from the writer-actuated or native-base forward, assembled in native operation order, installed at the two subject positions after block 9, and propagated through the untouched base suffix.
factorial.interpretation_boundary: This deliberately excludes block9 changes already written at later positions, including the separately measured H1/H4 final-query reader path; the full arm targets only the residual subject-state bypass.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_bypass: All authorities and fresh capability hold; native component recombination, empty/base closure, full/writer-subject-state closure, and Shapley efficiency are each within 1e-4; all records are finite and complete.
predictions.pred_b_residual_bypass_recurrence: The full component arm recovers within 0.03 of 0.0952 in A1 and 0.0579 in A2, with donorward fraction at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_carried_entry_dominates_bypass: Block9 entry has the largest positive Shapley value and its singleton retains at least 0.75 of the full bypass recovery in both families.
predictions.pred_d_block9_subject_updates_are_noness: Omitting attention9 or omitting MLP9 each retains at least 0.75 of the full bypass recovery in both families.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 20 model forwards, 640 example evaluations, eight arms, 512 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Identify the non-H1/H4 branch as carried subject-state transport across block 9.
terminal.null: The exact bypass cube is valid but the residual target or carried-entry prediction misses; retain the complete component accounting without promoting a bypass mechanism.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, component capture/recombination, closure, recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This localizes the residual half of a fresh writer effect after the selective block9 H1/H4 reader branch has been measured. It does not yet identify which later module consumes the carried state.
